description:
As Principal Engineer, Data Engineering, you will provide technical leadership for the data platforms, products, and engineering capabilities that power enterprise analytics, operational decision-making, and AI-enabled experiences. You will define the engineering direction for scalable, reliable, governed, and AI-ready data solutions while remaining deeply engaged in architecture, design, and implementation.
You will operate across engineering, product, analytics, architecture, and data science teams, solving complex technical problems, establishing reusable engineering patterns, and raising the technical bar across the organization.
Define the Future of Data Engineering
Develop multi-year technical roadmaps for enterprise data engineering capabilities, platforms, and data products.
Establish target-state architectures for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, serving, and consumption of enterprise data.
Define engineering strategies that support both analytical and operational workloads while enabling AI and intelligent experiences.
Drive modernization from tightly coupled pipelines and point solutions toward reusable, scalable, metadata-driven data platforms.
Evaluate emerging technologies and engineering approaches to identify opportunities to improve scale, performance, developer productivity, reliability, and cost.
Establish patterns that allow data to be consumed consistently by analytics, applications, APIs, AI systems, and enterprise platforms.
Lead Data Platform Engineering
Provide technical leadership for the design and implementation of large-scale enterprise data platforms.
Establish engineering patterns for batch, streaming, near-real-time, and event-driven data processing.
Define reference implementations for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, semantic models, and data-serving layers.
Build Trusted Enterprise Data Products
Establish data-product engineering practices that treat enterprise datasets as discoverable, governed, reliable, and reusable products.
Define standards for data contracts, ownership, service-level objectives, quality, lineage, documentation, and discoverability.
Drive engineering approaches that make trusted enterprise data available through tables, APIs, events, semantic layers, and AI-accessible interfaces.
Drive Engineering Excellence
Establish engineering standards for design, development, testing, deployment, observability, and production support.
Define patterns for automated testing across data pipelines, including unit, integration, data-quality, regression, and contract testing.
Drive observability practices across pipelines and data products, including freshness, completeness, quality, latency, failure detection, and cost.
Influence and Mentor
Serve as a trusted technical advisor to engineering, product, data, analytics, and technology leaders.
Provide technical leadership across teams without relying on direct organizational authority.
Mentor senior engineers, lead engineers, and engineering managers on architecture and engineering practices.
Create reference implementations, reusable components, engineering standards, and technical documentation that accelerate other teams.
Lead design reviews and technical communities of practice.
Raise engineering standards through code reviews, architecture reviews, technical deep dives, and hands-on problem solving.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, experimentation, accountability, operational ownership, and continuous learning.
We'd love to hear from people with...
Required Qualifications
12+ years of software, data, or platform engineering experience.
8+ years designing and building large-scale data platforms, pipelines, or distributed data systems.
Demonstrated experience serving as a technical lead for complex, enterprise-scale engineering initiatives.
Deep expertise in modern data engineering concepts including distributed processing, data modeling, orchestration, data quality, metadata, lineage, and data lifecycle management.
Strong hands-on experience with SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language such as Python, Java, or Scala.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, secure, observable, and cost-efficient production data platforms.
Strong understanding of DevOps and DataOps practices including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, monitoring, and production operations.
Experience establishing engineering standards and reusable technical patterns across multiple teams.
Proven ability to influence technical direction across large organizations without relying on direct authority.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical decisions to engineering and business leaders.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience with distributed data technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Delta Lake, or comparable platforms.
Experience building data products using lakehouse, data mesh, or domain-oriented architecture patterns.
Experience implementing enterprise data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, and observability.
Experience building data foundations for machine learning, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic AI.
Experience designing data services that expose governed enterprise data through APIs, event streams, semantic models, or AI-accessible interfaces.
Experience supporting large-scale operational environments where data freshness, accuracy, resiliency, and availability directly affect business operations.
Background in retail, hospitality, consumer services, or other large-scale distributed operational environments.

title: Account Executive, Amer Platform Grower (Velocity)
description:
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Platform Velocity Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. You will work with the next wave of startup platforms already using Stripe.
As a key member of the Stripe Platforms team, you will manage and elevate relationships with a named account list while identifying new growth opportunities and ways Stripe can exceed expectations.
What you'll do
As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe's online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.
Responsibilities
Directly manage and cultivate a named account list while crafting comprehensive account plans aimed at winning and expanding business with upper middle market and enterprise companies.
Build and sustain key relationships with C-level executives, ensuring the orchestration of appropriate executive touchpoints.
Contribute to the development of our platform partnership strategy by establishing repeatable processes and scalable engagement models.
Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture new business opportunities.
Own the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to closing sales with upper middle market and enterprise clients.
Coordinate and support the implementation of sold platforms and facilitate their effective utilization of Stripe products.
Foster relationships with executive stakeholders at both new and existing clients.
Collaborate with leaders across various functions (such as Engineering, Product, and Finance) to conduct complex product workshops and financial analyses.
Lead and contribute to team initiatives aimed at developing and refining our sales process.
Engage with Product and Engineering teams to shape and drive product strategy.
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
You are an adept salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. You get excited about prospecting and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. Finally, you enjoy building — you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.
If you're motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!
Minimum Requirements
At least 5 years of sales or prospecting experience, ideally within a technology company, with a consistent record of top performance.
Proven ability to manage a named account list and develop account plans for upper middle market and enterprise companies.
Experience building and maintaining relationships with C-level executives (CTO, COO, CFO).
Demonstrated ability to own and close a full sales cycle, from prospecting through to contract.
Strong analytical skills with experience helping customers model and quantify business investment decisions.
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Finance to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Pay and Benefits

What you’ll do
We're looking for an Accounts Receivable (AR) Specialist to join our growing team. The AR Specialist will own billing and collections programs for Stripe’s growing mix of products that are invoiced. This role is responsible for projects within the end‑to‑end billing cycle, reconciliation of billing outputs to Finance reporting, and supporting AR collections strategy and improvement. The role works closely with Finance, Sales/GTM, Product, Data/Engineering, and Accounting to ensure invoices are accurate, timely, and collected.

Own and execute defined Accounts Receivable (AR) programs and projects from planning through delivery, establishing scope, milestones, success measures, and accountability.
Develop and maintain project plans, track dependencies, and coordinate cross-functional execution to deliver agreed outcomes on time.
Translate AR business priorities into actionable workstreams, aligning stakeholders on requirements, deliverables, and ownership.
Proactively identify project risks, resolve execution blockers, and escalate decisions or trade-offs with clear recommendations.
Analyze AR performance and financial trends to identify gaps, investigate root causes, and recommend targeted improvements.
Partner with Finance, Sales/GTM, Engineering, and other stakeholders to deliver initiatives that improve receivables performance and the customer experience.
Lead process improvement projects that standardize and simplify AR workflows, reduce manual effort, and strengthen controls.
Gather business requirements and coordinate the prioritization, testing, and rollout of enhancements in partnership with technical teams.
Drive change management for assigned initiatives, including stakeholder communications, documentation, adoption planning, and post-launch measurement.
Define and monitor program metrics and leading indicators to measure business performance, delivery progress, and realized benefits.
Provide concise updates to AR and Finance leadership on program health, milestones, risks, decisions, and results.
Maintain program documentation, decision logs, and ownership handoffs to support sustainable outcomes and continuous improvement.
Own and execute subsidiary AR integration projects, aligning stakeholders on requirements, milestones, and dependencies while driving process improvements to standardize workflows, strengthen controls, and improve scalability.

Strong Excel/Sheets and SQL literacy; comfortable reading billing query outputs and reconciling to invoices.
Experience working with APIs, simple python scripts, or Retool automations preferred.
Familiarity with payment methods (ACH, wires, crypto/USDC, Stripe payment links) and cash application best practices.
Excellent attention to detail, organized, and able to manage a heavy month‑end cadence and ad hoc adjustments.
Strong communication skills and ability to partner cross‑functionally (Sales, Finance, Data, Product, Legal).
A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
A proven ability to be a self starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision
The ability to maintain high performance under tight timelines and a “roll up your sleeves” mindset to get any job done
The ability to bring structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment
Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems and data sets to make complex investigation decisions
Demonstrated history of taking on various types of challenging projects and producing results
Solution-oriented mindset with enthusiasm for establishing best practices
Self-disciplined, diligent, proactive and detail oriented
Preferred qualifications
Experience working at a high-growth technology or financial services company
Prior exposure to charge-through and pass‑through third‑party fees and complex fee constructs (platform fees, per txn, bps/% pricing, minimums).
Experience working at or supporting fintech or payments companies, especially crypto/stablecoin or cross‑border FX rails
Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or similar data stacks.

Design and implement controls for API key issuance, rotation, revocation, and abuse detection across user-facing keys and upstream provider credentials spanning multiple secrets engines and cloud boundaries. Serving as the primary on-site escalation path for critical field incidents and holding third-party recovery partners accountable, you will directly impact Zoox’s fleet availability, safety standards, and our ability to deliver a seamless experience to our riders.   Travel Requirements: less than 20%   Shift: 2nd Shift, Tuesday - Saturday, 4pm - 12am In this role, you will:

title: Production Engineer Team Lead
location: United States of America - Colorado - Denver
description:

Engineering Group
Job Description:
bpx energy, a major oil and gas producer in the United States, leverages its expertise in unconventional gas, including shale, to deliver hydrocarbon production and technical knowledge worldwide. With operations in Texas and Louisiana, our US onshore business has become both a premier oil and gas producer and a leader in reducing methane emissions.
As part of BP, a global industry leader, we foster a high-energy, high-intensity environment built on accountability, collegiality, innovation, and empowerment. At bpx, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and challenging environment where collaboration, continuous improvement, and inclusion are valued.
Discover your place with us and help our business meet the challenges of reimagining and reinventing the future of energy.
Role Synopsis
We are seeking an experienced Production Engineering Team Lead to head the Area Production Engineering team supporting the BPX Eagle Ford Operations team. The Eagle Ford is the cash flow engine of BPX with significant annual capital investment and a long-term plan to profitably grow production.
This role will lead a team of six Area Production Engineers who run the Eagle Ford base, partnering with Foremen, Optimizers, and Operations leadership to deliver production vs. target, minimize deferment, and protect well integrity across every route. The Team Lead will set a consistent surveillance and well performance management cadence, govern the well intervention portfolio, and work alongside the Projects, Technology & Artificial Lift team to make sure new standards, tools, and solutions are adopted and sustained in the field.
The Eagle Ford Operations engineering team is based out of Denver, CO and the Production Engineering Team Lead will report to the EagleFord Engineering Manager.
Key Accountabilities
Lead by example on safety and process safety; make sure the team's work supports safe field execution and that risks are identified, communicated, and managed before work begins.
Lead, coach, and develop a team of six Area Production Engineers; set clear performance expectations, assign area coverage, and balance workload, including vacancy and surge coverage.
Own base production performance for the Eagle Ford BU inclusive of production vs. target, uptime, and deferment vs. plan; ensure big movers are investigated and deferment is worked down with Operations.
Set and maintain the surveillance standard (what is reviewed, how often, and how issues are escalated) so every area is covered consistently.
Own the Production Engineering well intervention hopper: ensure every candidate has an economic case and work is prioritized across areas on value (IRR, payout, NPV).
Partner with the Interventions team on rig line loading, and lead post-job reviews comparing realized vs. forecast uplift to improve future scoping.
Ensure casing and annular pressures are monitored against Safe Operating Limits (SOL) and integrity limits with actions taken per procedure; support HSE, regulatory, and MOC requirements.
Hold the team accountable for accurate well status, well tests, and artificial lift data so allocation, targets, and reporting are correct.
Lead area plans with Reservoir Engineering, Facilities Engineering, and Development for tube-up timing, lift-type changes, and compression needs; own the handover of new wells into Area PE surveillance.
Partner with the Projects, Technology & Artificial Lift team: elevate recurring and cross-area problems, and own adoption of new AL standards, tools, and workflows in the areas.
Build a team culture of ownership, field partnership, and disciplined execution, and support rotations between Area and Projects roles to grow capability across Production Engineering.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering
10+ years of experience in production / petroleum engineering
Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or coaching engineers

Experience in unconventional operations, including well surveillance, deferment management, and well intervention planning
Knowledgeable in gas lift, rod lift, plunger lift, and GAPL/PAGL design, troubleshooting and optimization
Experience with choke management and nodal analysis to implement optimal drawdown and FBHP management
Experience building intervention economic cases and managing a prioritized portfolio of well work
Familiarity with well integrity management, production allocation, and well test practices

Adventurous: Willing to get hands-on with our most valuable asset – the production specialists in the field – and earn credibility with Foremen and Optimizers.
Creative and Courageous: Ability to look at an industry that is embedded in its methods and recommend disruptive change, and to champion new ways of working within the team.
